name: kit-part-ram-bar
prompt: phobosvanilla, ORTHOGRAPHIC VERTICAL OVERHEAD PLAN VIEW, camera directly above. Draw it in exactly the art style of the reference image: a top-down game sprite seen from directly above, a thick near-black outline around every shape, soft flat cel shading with two or three tones per material, pale panels, rounded corners. subject: a heavy steel ram bar seen from directly above, drawn alone
